answer: Put newcomers in a shared tide pool with a fixed reward budget per epoch, split by audited contribution: adding fake identities only dilutes the attacker's own share, so Sybils steal from themselves. Each identity's work carries a pigment fingerprint derived from its long-lived key, letting auditors collapse lookalike outputs into one share. A rotating forge committee re-executes sampled jobs; failures burn the bond and void the pool share.
